The team was led by sixth-year [[head coach]] [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]], and played their home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]]. ==Previous season== Arkansas did not continue the momentum it had built in [[2014–15 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|2014–15]], after finishing second to [[2014–15 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the [[2014–15 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC]] and winning a game in the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] for the first time in seven years. They lost [[Chicago Bulls]] forward [[Bobby Portis]] to the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] and [[Michael Qualls]] also declared but was not drafted after sustaining a knee injury. Seniors Rashad Madden and Alandise Harris graduated, and Nick Babb elected to transfer to [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]]. In the offseason, returning players Jacorey Williams and Anton Beard, along with Colorado transfer Dustin Thomas, were involved in a counterfeiting scandal and Williams was later kicked off the team. Beard was suspended for the first semester and Thomas had to sit out the season anyway as part of NCAA transfer rules.{{cite web|url=http://www.wholehogsports.com/news/2015/jul/22/two-hogs-arrested-forgery/|title=WholeHogSports - Three Hogs arrested on forgery charges released|publisher=wholehogsports.com|accessdate=2016-03-10}} The Razorbacks lost to [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] in the second round of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
